module.authentication.peer-sender.title: Peer and sender authentication scope
module.authentication.peer-sender.description: Selects peer, sender, device, and service authentication outcomes and bounded impersonation or malicious-participant threats.
assumptions: The operator identifies the peer, sender, device, and service identities relevant to the assessed communication boundary.
exclusions: Authentication scope does not assert identity proofing quality, authorization, approval, or product conformance.

module.binding.identity-session-transcri.title: Identity, session, and transcript binding scope
module.binding.identity-session-transcri.description: Selects identity, role, session, context or epoch, and transcript binding outcomes plus misbinding and transcript-splicing threats.
assumptions: The assessed design declares the identity, role, session, context or epoch, and transcript boundaries that require binding.
exclusions: Selection does not infer that any runtime identity or transcript has been validated.

module.communication.confidentiality-int.title: Communication confidentiality and integrity scope
module.communication.confidentiality-int.description: Selects protocol-neutral message, key-material, message-integrity, and state-integrity outcomes together with representative disclosure and modification threats.
assumptions: The assessment scope identifies which communication content and key material are intended to remain confidential and which state transitions require integrity.
exclusions: Selection does not prescribe a cipher, protocol, key size, implementation, or deployment architecture.

module.compromise.forward-secrecy.title: Forward-secrecy assumptions
module.compromise.forward-secrecy.description: Selects compromise-scope and forward-secrecy outcomes with historical-exposure threats under explicitly bounded compromise assumptions.
assumptions: The operator explicitly declares which secret classes may be compromised and which earlier communication intervals are in scope.
exclusions: Selection does not assert that forward secrecy is achieved or that historical material is absent.

module.compromise.post-compromise-recove.title: Post-compromise recovery assumptions
module.compromise.post-compromise-recove.description: Selects compromise-scope and post-compromise-recovery outcomes with continued-access and compromise-propagation threats.
assumptions: The assessed design declares the compromise event, recovery transition, recovery authority, and interval for which recovery is evaluated.
exclusions: Selection does not assert that a compromise occurred, recovery succeeded, or residual access was eliminated.

module.evidence.private-provenance.title: Private evidence provenance
module.evidence.private-provenance.description: Marks private-evidence provenance as unsupported by CCA-130 because provenance, freshness, retention, and access semantics remain reserved for CCA-240.
module.evidence.private-provenance.reason: CCA-130 defines descriptive module composition only and has no private-evidence provenance contract.
module.evidence.private-provenance.scope: CCA-240 evidence provenance, freshness, retention, and access semantics
assumptions: A later separately authorized contract is required before private evidence can be referenced with provenance semantics.
exclusions: This unsupported entry does not authorize private-evidence access, collection, retention, correlation, or publication.

module.evidence.publication-boundary.title: Evidence publication boundary scope
module.evidence.publication-boundary.description: Selects the public or private classification-boundary outcome with prohibited-content and private-evidence disclosure threats.
assumptions: The operator explicitly classifies material before any publication decision outside profile resolution.
exclusions: Selection does not authorize evidence access, disclosure, publication, retention, approval, or release.

module.keys.derivation-separation.title: Key derivation and separation scope
module.keys.derivation-separation.description: Selects derivation-context and key-role separation outcomes with context-collision and role-reuse threats.
assumptions: The operator identifies the intended derivation contexts and distinct key roles within the assessed scope.
exclusions: Selection does not prescribe a KDF, cryptographic algorithm, label format, or key size.

module.keys.lifecycle.title: Key lifecycle scope
module.keys.lifecycle.description: Selects storage, rotation, revocation, destruction, and recovery outcomes with bounded lifecycle-boundary threats.
assumptions: The assessed scope declares the key lifecycle states and the authority responsible for each transition.
exclusions: Selection does not define operational custody, retention, access control, or risk acceptance.

module.negotiation.downgrade-agility.title: Downgrade resistance and algorithm agility scope
module.negotiation.downgrade-agility.description: Selects downgrade, algorithm-confusion, and agility outcomes with bounded negotiation and transition threats.
assumptions: The assessed design declares its negotiation inputs, accepted transition states, and algorithm identifiers.
exclusions: Selection does not recommend an algorithm, cipher suite, transition schedule, or universal strongest configuration.

module.privacy.metadata.title: Communication metadata privacy scope
module.privacy.metadata.description: Selects communication-metadata and observable-pattern outcomes with traffic-analysis and side-channel correlation threats.
assumptions: The operator identifies which metadata, timing, length, and communication relationships are intended to be protected.
exclusions: Selection does not assert traffic-analysis resistance, anonymity, unlinkability, or side-channel absence.

module.randomness.nonce-entropy.title: Nonce and randomness assumptions
module.randomness.nonce-entropy.description: Selects nonce-uniqueness and entropy-assumption outcomes with bounded reuse and weak-randomness threats.
assumptions: The assessed design documents every randomness source and every scope in which nonce uniqueness is required.
exclusions: Selection does not choose, implement, seed, or certify a random-number generator.

module.replay.ordering-freshness.title: Replay, ordering, freshness, and rollback scope
module.replay.ordering-freshness.description: Selects replay or duplicate rejection, ordering, freshness, and rollback outcomes with representative network and persistent-state threats.
assumptions: The assessment scope declares the ordering, freshness, duplicate-handling, and durable-state boundaries that matter to the product.
exclusions: Selection does not prescribe a sequence-number, clock, nonce, storage, or recovery mechanism.

module.resilience.fail-closed-state-reco.title: Fail-closed behavior and state recovery scope
module.resilience.fail-closed-state-reco.description: Selects fail-closed, availability, and state-recovery outcomes with resource, malformed-input, and state-fork threats.
assumptions: The assessed product boundary declares safe failure behavior, availability expectations, and authoritative recovery state.
exclusions: Selection does not define service-level objectives, operational incident response, or proof of fail-closed behavior.

module.threat.active-network-adversary.title: Active network adversary scope
module.threat.active-network-adversary.description: Selects the bounded active-network-controller attacker model so its declared capability set remains explicit in a resolved profile.
assumptions: The assessed threat model permits the bounded network operations declared by the selected attacker model.
exclusions: Selection does not infer attacker presence, exploitability, likelihood, severity, or a confirmed vulnerability.
